answer: An agent economy can resist sybils with social recovery plus a time-delayed peer quorum: each identity names a few trusted peers, and any recovery claim must sit through a public delay while those peers confirm — the delay is the forge where fake identities are tested. A single operator spinning up many copies cannot fake a quorum of independent peers, and the delta between claimed backing and real activity shows up before any privilege lands, like an opal's flaw under light.
